dtsPropsFor.AnswerKeyAccordion:
/** Raw markdown of the answer key. Rendered collapsed inside a native <details>, on the `streak` warning surface. Empty string renders a "chưa có đáp án" fallback. */
  answerKeyMd: string;
dtsPropsFor.ExplanationSlot:
/** Explanation text shown under a graded question. Renders `null` when absent. */
  explanation: string | null;
dtsPropsFor.MarkdownContent:
/** Markdown body. Leading YAML front-matter is stripped automatically. GFM tables/strikethrough supported. */
  content: string;
dtsPropsFor.LectureToc:
/** Headings extracted from the lecture markdown (see `extractToc`). */
  entries: { id: string; text: string }[];
